nom: Dermalogica Dynamic Skin Recovery Moisturizer SPF 50

segments.oily: Reviewers with an oily forehead or oily-prone skin report the product does not trigger breakouts and controls shine without feeling oily or overly dewy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as very hydrating, soft-making, and a repurchase staple, with one noting it as the only moisturizer that keeps her dry skin feeling soft.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin says it feels wonderful and is never greasy or drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, no redness, and no reaction even where other products or chemicals bother them, though one with rosacea-like sensitivity had a burning, greasy, red reaction to a chemical formula concern.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing aging or mature skin report visible reduction in fine lines, improved elasticity, and a firmer, smoother look over time.

concerns.aging: Several long-term users report fewer wrinkles, improved elasticity, firmer and smoother skin, and a younger-looking complexion over months to years of use; one reviewer notes it is too early to judge anti-aging results.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe strong, fast-absorbing hydration that leaves skin soft, smooth and glowing without heaviness; one reviewer with dry skin still called it 'a little heavy' though it absorbed quickly.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports her persistent redness and acne resolved with no breakouts after three weeks; another reviewer's mild rosacea became inflamed, red and irritated after using it.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a history of reacting to chemicals reports no irritation at all and calls it the first SPF she can wear; another reports eye irritation and burning likely linked to the sunscreen filters.
concerns.spots: Multiple long-term users report fading of hyperpigmentation and dark patches, and reduced sun damage/pigmentation over months to years of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including one with acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts; one reviewer with acne-prone skin describes it breaking her out every time despite other benefits, and one describes it causing her skin to bump up.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say it does not make skin oily or greasy and controls an oily forehead without breakouts; one reviewer notes it felt 'a bit on the greasy side' despite good results.

aspects.libelle: High price for amount of product
Travel size convenient for purse or carry-on

extraits.titre: Changed my sensitive and redness prone skin
extraits.texte: I got this as a sample for my birthday gift. My skin has changed after having persistent acne and redness since the 7th grade (I am 25 now)! Just after three weeks. I have bought all of the minis from this brand and im obsessed. I experience no redness when i apply it and i have had 0 breakouts. Great for sensitive skin!!

This has great benefits, I love that it has SPF50 and it gives me a wonderful glow after. However, this breaks me out every time I use it. I've had this product for months and I didn't know for sure if it was from this product since I noticed I didn't have any the beginning of me using it. I decided to stop using it and my face was getting better. I'm so sad because this is not a cheap brand and this was definitely on the pricer side. I love their stabilizing repair cream super great. But I'll have to give this to a family member to see if it works better for them.

On my quest to find a good sunscreen after 30 years of not being diligent about using it, (i know shame on me), this Dermalogica Skin Recovery was unfortunately a miss. The smell is extrnely strong and herbal. Not horrible on its own, but add that it burned my face and left it greasy and red for awhile, i cant be continuing to use it. Like the high spf, but i think the lesson for me, personally, is that mineral sunscreen is the way to go since rhe chemical sunscreens seem to make my seemingly mild rosacea that i had under control, just completly inflamed again.

extraits.titre: Keep coming back to this product
extraits.texte: This is my all time favorite. My oily forehead doesn't breakout with this. It does a great job moisturizing the rest of my drier spots. Have tried other products, as it is pricey, but keep coming back to this one. Nothing beats it. The SPF is great too. If I am out during the day, I can tell on my other skin that my face and neck were protected.
this is by far the best spf cream I've found. im 39 and i have dry skin. this product helps me get nice smooth skin. I've gotten rid of so many wrinkles in my face by using this product religiously.

When I started using this product my skin had hyperpigmentation areas that were so embarrassing. My stepdad even asked me one day what happened to my face after he hadn't seen me in a while without makeup :/ I wasn't treating it, just covering it up with makeup. After using this product a while one day I realized my dark areas (most of my forehead and above my lips) were fading. I hadn't changed anything else. Today I no longer have any hyperpigmentation on my face. I have to credit that to this product because again, it was the only thing I had changed in my routine. I use this daily and I highly recommend it.

Have used this over the last few years and I actually really like it. Like to have the added SPF to my aging skin ( along with the SPF of my foundation but much lower) if I'm out I actually always have a hat on. I'm always working with my skin care line to minimize or get rid of sunspots/ age spots. The cream is that, a creamâ€¦ it's alittle heavy. But it absorbs quickly leaving no white on your face and no residue. Alittle goes a long way too. Don't over pump!!! I will definitely continue to use.
